title: Azzurro Moon | KEY.co
description_expanded: Beautifully appointed bedroom suites provide serene retreats, many with balcony access and stunning coastal vistas. The home’s crowning feature is its spectacular rooftop terrace, where a sleek private pool and sun loungers overlook the sparkling Gulf, offering an unforgettable setting for sun-soaked afternoons and peaceful evenings under the stars. With direct beach access via a shared boardwalk, on-site parking, complimentary beach setup, six adult bikes, and a six-seater golf cart, the property makes exploring the charm of Seagrove Beach effortless. Nearby favorites such as Old Florida Fish House, Beachy Bean Coffee Co., and Buddy’s Seafood Market add to the experience, creating a stay defined by comfort, style, and the timeless beauty of the Emerald Coast. Perched along the pristine shoreline of Seagrove Beach, this newly built Gulf-front villa captures the essence of elevated 30A living. Spanning more than 4,200 square feet across four thoughtfully designed levels, the home blends refined coastal style with modern luxury while comfortably accommodating up to 14 guests. Expansive picture windows frame sweeping Gulf views, filling the interiors with natural light and the calming presence of the water. A private elevator connects each floor, while elegant gathering spaces—including a welcoming media lounge, a sophisticated living room with a gas fireplace, and a chef’s kitchen featuring Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances—create the perfect setting for relaxing and entertaining by the sea.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
